title: Reacting with Exclamations
goal: React quickly to news with exclamations such as ¡Qué pena que...! and ¡Qué bien que...!

sections.title: Unit 6, Lesson 3: Reacting with Exclamations
body: An exclamation is the quickest way to react. There is no verb of feeling: the exclamation carries the feeling, and the clause after que is what you react to.
You will practise ¡Qué pena que...!, ¡Qué bien que...! and ¡Qué bueno que...! with the subjunctive, and ¡Menos mal que...! with the indicative.

items: I can react to news with ¡Qué pena que...!, ¡Qué bien que...! and ¡Qué bueno que...!
I can say ¡Menos mal que...! with the indicative to show relief.
I can use the new words for exclamations.
